def proof_counts(report,seq):
 assert isinstance(report,dict) and type(seq)is int and seq>0
 assert type(report['seq'])is int and report['seq']==seq
 keys=('spans','nulls','d5_nonnull')
 if 'counts' in report:
  assert isinstance(report['counts'],dict) and not any(k in report for k in keys)
  source=report['counts']
 else:
  assert report['status']=='PASS_ACTUAL_CANONICAL_AND_FULL_SOURCE_REPRODUCTION'
  source=report
 counts={k:source[k] for k in keys}
 assert all(type(n)is int for n in counts.values())
 assert counts['spans']>0 and 0<=counts['nulls']<=counts['spans']
 assert 0<=counts['d5_nonnull']<=counts['spans']-counts['nulls']
 return counts
